description: Turning free names into new constant symbols gives a bijection between \(L\)-formulas with names in \(\alpha\) and sentences in \(L\cup\{c_a:a\in\alpha\}\).
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Formula.equivSentence.{u, v, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type u'} :
  L.Formula α ≃ (L.withConstants α).Sentence
